approved: Customs Tariff Amendment (Incorporation of Proposals) Bill 2013

Moved a bill making minor technical corrections to five items in schedule 4 of the Customs Tariff Act, including clarifying that a batch repair concession applies, removing outdated wording on industrial processing, and fixing a drafting error that had changed gross construction tons to tonnes for vessel parts duty concessions.

Explained the Customs Tariff Amendment Bill makes minor technical corrections to five items in schedule 4 of the Customs Tariff Act, including reinstating the word wheelchairs and fixing a tons-to-tonnes error, implementing a tariff proposal that took effect on 1 March 2013.

Summed up the Customs Tariff Amendment Bill as formally incorporating five minor amendments to schedule 4 concessional duty items, tabled in February 2013, into the Customs Tariff Act following the 2012 Better Regulation Ministerial Partnership review.

The bill amends the Customs Tariff Act 1995 to incorporate technical changes from a March 2013 tariff proposal, including clearer definitions and corrections to items 20, 21, 27, 30, and 35 in schedule 4. The coalition supported the amendments as uncontroversial.
